__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes Scryer's /metrics endpoint.

description: Scryer operations dashboard: serving, acquisition, indexers, downloads, imports, jobs and health. Metric reference: scryer-docs/deployment/prometheus-metrics.md.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Running Scryer version, from scryer_build_info.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the metrics recorder came up at boot.

panels.title: Download clients down
panels.description: Configured download clients whose last queue read failed.

panels.title: Indexers in backoff
panels.description: Indexers currently excluded from searches by failure backoff.

panels.title: Health errors
panels.description: Health-check sources currently reporting an error.

panels.title: Queue items
panels.description: Items currently projected in the download queue, all states.

panels.title: Grabs (24h)
panels.description: Releases sent to a download client in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Imports (24h)
panels.description: Completed imports in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: HTTP requests by status class
panels.description: Responses per second by status class. Counts middleware rejections (rate limit, CORS, authless guard) too.

panels.title: HTTP latency (all routes)
panels.description: Wall-clock latency measured at the outermost layer, so it includes compression and rate limiting.

panels.title: HTTP p95 latency by route (top 10)
panels.description: Route is the axum template, so path parameters never fan out.

panels.title: GraphQL operations by root field (top 10)
panels.description: Queries, mutations and subscription starts per second. Subscriptions count once, at start.

panels.title: GraphQL errors by root field
panels.description: Operations that returned at least one GraphQL error, by root field.

panels.title: In-flight requests and WebSocket connections
panels.description: Open HTTP requests and live GraphQL WebSocket connections (one per browser tab).

panels.title: Grabs by trigger
panels.description: Releases handed to a download client per interval: rss, auto (search), season_pack, pending (delay expired), manual.

panels.title: Grab submissions by result
panels.description: Every submission attempt. grabbed = new download; reused = already in a client; conflict = another claim won; deferred = delay profile; failed = client or indexer error.

panels.title: Candidates rejected by reason (top 8)
panels.description: Why the decision gate said no. A sudden rise in one reason usually means a profile or indexer change.

panels.title: Automatic searches and results
panels.description: Background searches completed and candidate releases they returned, per facet.

panels.title: RSS sync cycles by outcome
panels.description: completed = a real sync; no_titles / no_clients = the cycle had nothing to do. Expect one bar every 15 minutes.

panels.title: RSS releases fetched, matched, grabbed
panels.description: Funnel per RSS cycle. matched at zero with fetched high means nothing wanted is being published.

panels.title: Indexer queries by indexer and status
panels.description: Outbound query attempts per second. An indexer that disappears from here and shows up in skips is backed off.

panels.title: Indexers in backoff
panels.description: Indexers currently excluded from searches, when the exclusion ends, and how many consecutive failures escalated it. Empty is good.

panels.title: Indexer p95 query latency
panels.description: Per-indexer p95 round trip. Compare against the indexer's own timeout.

panels.title: Indexer skips by reason
panels.description: Indexers dropped before a request was sent. backoff and system_backoff are the ones to chase; disabled and mode_disabled are configuration.

panels.title: Indexer errors by class
panels.description: Classified failures written to the indexer error history. newznab_invalid_api_key and newznab_request_limit_reached need an operator; http_server_error is the indexer's problem.

panels.title: Queries by search mode
panels.description: interactive = a person searching; auto = background searches; rss = the 15-minute sync.

panels.title: Results per indexer
panels.description: Candidate releases returned per interval. An indexer with a healthy query rate and zero results here is misconfigured, not down.

panels.title: Outbound 429s by scope
panels.description: HTTP 429 responses received from indexers and other upstreams. Each one arms a cooldown for that destination.

panels.title: Download queue items by state
panels.description: Client-side states. A growing import_pending band means imports are stuck, not downloads.

panels.title: Download client reachability
panels.description: 1 when the last queue read from the client succeeded. Red stretches line up with refresh errors below.

panels.title: Queue snapshot age
panels.description: Seconds since the queue projection was last refreshed. Flat-lining upward means the poller is stuck or every client is unreadable.

panels.title: Download client read errors
panels.description: Failed reads per second by client and read kind (queue, history, recent activity).

panels.title: Download client p95 read latency
panels.description: Per-client read time. Note this family changed meaning in 0.20: it used to be the whole poll cycle, which is now scryer_download_queue_poll_cycle_duration_seconds.

panels.title: Failed and ignored downloads
panels.description: Downloads that ended in failure at the client, and downloads Scryer chose to ignore.

panels.title: Snapshot refresh results
panels.description: partial = the snapshot was published although at least one client read failed.

panels.title: Poll cycle p95 duration
panels.description: Whole queue poll cycle across all clients. Should stay well under the poll interval.

panels.title: Imports, upgrades and rejections
panels.description: Completed imports, files replaced by a better release, and imports refused.

panels.title: Import rejections by reason
panels.description: disk_full, permission_denied and password_required need an operator; already_imported and duplicate_file are normal noise.

panels.title: Imported bytes
panels.description: Bytes moved into the library per second.

panels.title: Media files deleted by reason
panels.description: upgrade_cleanup is expected alongside upgrades; missing_on_disk means something outside Scryer removed files.

panels.title: Library scans by outcome
panels.description: Scans that reached a terminal state.

panels.title: Import lane p95 wait
panels.description: Time an import waited for a lane permit. Sustained waits mean the lanes are saturated.

panels.title: Health checks
panels.description: One lane per health source. Filter by a single instance for this panel; the sum does not aggregate across instances.

targets.expr: (max by (source) (scryer_health_check_status{instance=~"$instance", status="error"}) * 2) + (max by (source) (scryer_health_check_status{instance=~"$instance", status="warning"}) * 1) + (max by (source) (scryer_health_check_status{instance=~"$instance", status="ok"}) * 0)

panels.title: Scheduled jobs
panels.description: Time since each job last succeeded, when it runs next, and failures in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Root folder free space
panels.description: Free fraction of every configured root folder, from the disk-space health check.

panels.title: Task p95 duration
panels.description: Scheduled task run time. Tasks that never finish never appear here; check the freshness gauges instead.

panels.title: Task errors and panics
panels.description: A panic is always a bug worth reporting; an error is usually an upstream failure.

panels.title: Time since last successful task run
panels.description: Sawtooth is healthy: it resets on every success. A line that keeps climbing is a task that stopped succeeding.

panels.title: Background worker errors and stale recoveries
panels.description: Long-running worker loops that hit an error or recovered a stale claim.

panels.title: Destinations in cooldown
panels.description: Upstream destinations Scryer is currently refusing to call because of a recent 429.

panels.title: Rate-limit waits by destination
panels.description: Requests that had to wait for a cooldown to end or for a per-host requests-per-second slot.

panels.title: Transport retries and backoff p95
panels.description: Retries after connection-level failures, by scope.

panels.title: Domain events by type (top 10)
panels.description: Everything the application publishes on its event stream.

panels.title: Metadata hydration
panels.description: Title metadata fetches from the metadata gateway.

panels.title: Hydration backlog and wanted projection
panels.description: Titles waiting for metadata, and the size of the wanted projection by kind.

panels.title: Subtitles
panels.description: Subtitle downloads and failed subtitle searches.

title: Scryer
